title: Weekly technology snapshot of your client sites, to spot CMS, analytics and plugin changes
who: Web agencies that manage a mix of WordPress, static and Shopify sites and want to notice when a client site changes its stack.
notes: Run it every week with --json snapshots/YYYY-MM-DD.json, then compare two snapshots offline: node src/cli.js diff snapshots/2026-11-16.json snapshots/2026-11-23.json --out changes.csv. Replace the sample urls with your own list (--urls-file clients.txt). A site that was blocked or failed in either run is listed as not-comparable, never as 'nothing changed'.
